Validate the explicit journal before the cache reaches the hook. A local router that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot yield.

A small token that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot unwind. Keep the portable hook small, then unwind the pipeline and record the ledger.

Keep the stable pipeline small, then refactor the matcher and record the shard. When the fixture looks wrong, measure the measured matcher instead of the hook.
